record.kind: OnDamageReceivedEffect (shared instance): one-shot below 50% HP that lays TOXIC_SPIKES board effects and deals special damage
record.summary: PassiveEffects[Passive.GLIMMORA] holds one shared OnDamageReceivedEffect (ToxicSpikesEffect). It runs after the unit receives damage (taken damage > 0 and hp still above 0). If the unit's passive is still GLIMMORA and hp < 0.5 x maxHP, it first calls changePassive(NONE) (so it can fire once per entity), then takes the cells at x-1..x+1 and y offsets +1,+2 (RED_TEAM: -2,-1) that are on the board. For each such cell it adds the TOXIC_SPIKES board effect (the occupant, of any team, also gains the effect unless it holds Heavy Duty Boots), broadcasts the animation, and, if the occupant belongs to another team, requests handleSpecialDamage(20, board, SPECIAL, the unit, crit false) with the default apBoost true, so the unit's AP scales the 20. The board effect is read by the once-per-second status routine: an entity carrying TOXIC_SPIKES that is not POISON type and has no Heavy Duty Boots gets triggerPoison(1000) on itself every second. The 20 is a requested raw amount before AP, special defense, shields and Protect.
triggers: OnDamageReceivedEffect: after any received damage with takenDamage > 0 and hp > 0

effects.declaredRaw: fires when hp < 0.5 x maxHP after a received damage event and the passive is still GLIMMORA
effects.resolution: the check runs only inside onDamageReceived, which handleDamage calls when takenDamage > 0 and hp > 0 (core-mechanics section J1: takenDamage includes shield damage, so a hit absorbed entirely by a shield can also run the check; hp is compared after the hit). A killing blow does not run it. changePassive(NONE) runs before the spikes, removing the shared effect instance for this entity.

effects.declaredRaw: requested 20 SPECIAL damage, attacker = the unit, crit false, apBoost default true, to each enemy-team occupant of the selected cells
effects.scaling: apBoost true: amount = 20 + 20 x unit.ap / 100 (before rounding inside handleDamage); no crit; no star scaling. The occupant list is read from the cells when the loop runs.
effects.resolution: requested 20; applied = 20 x (1 + AP/100) before the target's special defense (core-mechanics section A) and the floor of 1; handleSpecialDamage returns takenDamage 0 for a target with status.protect, skydiving or magicBounce; shield damage counts in takenDamage (section J1). The return value is discarded here. Occupants of the unit's own team are skipped for damage but still get the board effect.

effects.declaredRaw: TOXIC_SPIKES board effect on up to 6 cells; carriers get triggerPoison(1000) every second unless POISON type or Heavy Duty Boots
effects.scaling: none from AP at this site; triggerPoison is called with the carrier as target and origin undefined
effects.resolution: the effect is applied to the current occupant of each cell (any team, not only enemies) and to entities that later move into the cell; entities lose it by leaving. The poison amount per tick (what triggerPoison does with the 1000 ms argument) was not traced.

record.geometry: 3 columns (x-1, x, x+1) by 2 rows. Default (non-RED) rows are the unit's y+1 and y+2; RED_TEAM rows are y-2 and y-1; cells off the board are skipped, so a unit near an edge covers fewer than 6 cells. The unit's own row is not included.
conditions: hp < 0.5 x maxHP at the moment onDamageReceived runs (current hp after the hit, maxHP as stored)
passive must still be GLIMMORA (it is changed to NONE on firing)
applies to GLIMMET and GLIMMORA regardless of team; the geometry depends on team
record.resetBehaviour: changePassive(NONE) is the only reset; the effect cannot fire again for this entity. Board effects persist on the cells; the one clearing path found (simulation.ts:1784) belongs to another mechanism and was not traced. A resurrection path re-running the passive was not traced.
